title: Woman Jumping into Pool
description: A heavy woman with wet curly dark hair is captured mid-air as she jumps feet-first into a swimming pool, creating a big splash and colorful ripples. Her eyes are closed and mouth smiling, she wears a purple one-piece swimsuit with gold patterns, one hand touches the diving board while the other is outstretched, in an old indoor pool with painted walls.
prompt: A heavy woman with wet curly dark hair and a smiling face with closed eyes is captured mid-air jumping feet first into a swimming pool, creating a large colorful splash and swirling ripples in the water. She wears a purple one-piece swimsuit with small gold patterns, one hand touches the edge of a diving board while the other arm is outstretched, in an old indoor public pool with painted walls showing faded figures and paint marks, realistic painting style with detailed water and light reflections.
